allow: Running `gh pr merge` on an open pull request is allowed without further confirmation when this repository's CLAUDE.md documents a standing user pre-authorization for automatic merges (a chat instruction to merge that specific PR, or a cycle-start instruction to auto-merge). The required post-merge verification (conflict-marker grep + smoke test) must still run and be reported regardless.

Writing and running code that spawns background Claude Code sessions via `claude --bg` is allowed for the 양비스 command center at C:\dev\command-center. On 2026-09-08 the user granted summoning as a capability but required that every summon be triggered by their own explicit voice or text command through the status window: the orchestrator only queues numbered proposals and never spawns on its own, and a session that modifies anything must additionally show what it will change before the user approves. `claude agents`, `claude logs`, and `claude stop` are allowed so spawned sessions can always be listed and terminated.
